system.description:
This bizarre social art is apparently a method of coercion and persuasion among Dwarvenkind and consists of a lot of backslapping, grinning and reassurances: “Come on! You’ll love it.” That other folk often find it charming and endearing is one of the wonders of the world.

Obstacles: Obstacle is equal to the victim’s Will. Obstacle increases for really outlandish requests and proposals. It may be used as Persuasion in a Duel of Wits.

FoRKs: Intimidation, Interrogation, Ugly Truth

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Restrictions: Dwarves only

Root: Will (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 265
